register.title: Supplier registration
register.subtitle: Fresh Market PreConnect
register.accept_required: Please accept the account approval process information.
register.password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
register.consent_process_understanding: I understand that the account is subject to admin review. Until approval I can sign in and complete my profile, but I cannot send submissions to retailers or take part in B2B Meetings.
register.consent_data_visibility: My data will be visible to buyers from retailers and distributors only to the extent I send them a submission, select them within B2B Meetings, or am matched with them under the accepted FM B2B procedure. The Operator does not share data with other recipients for marketing purposes; data may be processed by technical providers acting on behalf of the Operator (list in the Privacy Policy).

register.success_profile_hint: In the meantime you can sign in and complete your company profile: add a logo, description, and certificates. PreConnect (submissions to retailers) and B2B Meetings will be available after activation.
